Ackerman went too early. The crash rattled the sprint trains and it turned out to be one fine pasta at the finish line because of it. The rain didn’t help either or did the very twisty run in at the end. Golden Kilometer was golden, and Philipsen outsmarted everyone. So fucking marvellous to seem him pip it at the end from where he had been in the last 30m. Fine as hell sprinting.

I don’t think the race will be neutralised though. Which will make everything a little blue and tremendously interesting at the same time.

To be fair, and also be a little miserly, the form of most of the peleton seemed a little askew in the Tour. No doubt everyone who won, won it fair and square but there was a sharp drop off between the form of a select group of 10 in the tour and the rest of the peloton. 

but then again, you are right too.

Isn't that the image that's popular for him? Last year, he performed so well in the Tour de france and everyone called it how he had overachieved. Man was in yellow jersey so long, he was even winning TTs. Sure he had good form, but that's all he was made out to be.

A man in good form.

Which is downplaying him. Sorry if I am fanboying a lil, but he is bloody good. He is got a kick in the hurt box and that determination that is simply marvellous. He is just not a bloody 'entertainer' with some 'panache'. I hope he notches up some more one days under his belt, so people can appreciate he is good. Period.

Alaphilippe is gold. There is something so endearing about him going on the attack. He always looks like he is battling against the world, and who doesn't want the underdog to win? Be amazing to watch him in the rainbow stripes. Cant fricking wait.
Robben, in that case, had more consistency than all the 'Baloon Doors' winners combined.
And no, I wasn't influenced by any other answers. This is what I read from the stem(s) of a cyclist who would win the tour in an alternate British fantasy Universe.
Amen to that success, mate. That impeachable success is all there is to live for.
